description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Moritte of the Frost and another permanent you control.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Moritte of the Frost
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
